title: Costa Brava kayaking and snorkeling
text: We did the Costa Bravo kayaking and snorkeling tour with Mario. We had a fantastic time. He was always checking to make sure we were happy and had everything we needed. He was one of the best guides we ever had! The area was beautiful! Thanks again Mario!!
author: wtcgus

title: Life finds a way
text:
We went on the hiking and snorkeling tour with Mario, and after reading the other reviews, we had heard great things about his tour planning and friendliness. We thought he would probably be a great person to go with, but from the moment we were picked up at 8 a.m. until we were dropped off at 4 p.m., he completely lived up to the reviews,  if not more so.

We spent a week in Spain and had quite a few tour guides, but Mario was one of the only two who really stood out to me as someone who was genuinely passionate about giving tours, helping others, and showing us his world.

title: Look no further. Book this hike and snorkel tour.
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ AN ABSOLUTE MUST DO IN BARCELONA!

We were a group visiting from Arizona, and the Costa Brava Hike and Snorkel was hands down one of the highlights of our entire trip to Spain.

The Costa Brava itself is absolutely incredible. The coastline, hidden coves, crystal clear water, hiking, and snorkeling were everything we hoped for and more. Pictures simply do not do this place justice.

title: Mario is the best guide in Costa Brava!
text: This was the BEST part of our trip to Spain! Costa Brava is absolutely stunning. Mario took us on a great hike with beautiful views of different coves with picturesque turquoise water. Ended with great snorkeling - better snorkeling than Mallorca - and a quick bite to eat. Mario as our guide really made the entire day extremely fun. We would do this again in a heartbeat.
author: Z2608ANjoeyr

title: Highly recommended, especially with Mario
text:
We went on an excursion along the Costa Brava with Mario and the experience was great. He came to pick us up on time with the van and took us to see different coves in the Palamós area, explaining a lot of interesting things about the Costa Brava to us.

Before leaving us time to enjoy and swim at one of the beaches, he taught us some tips for snorkeling and explained what species we could find in the sea; he even told us about fish, octopuses, and other animals we could see. It was clear that he is passionate about what he does and that he knows the area very well.
